mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sla_pause_log (work_order_id, pause_reason, operator_id, pause_time, original_response_deadline, original_sla_deadline) VALUES (#{workOrderId}, #{pauseReason}, #{operatorId}, #{pauseTime}, #{originalResponseDeadline}, #{originalSlaDeadline})
